service.description: Start sharing the current user's location, the owner, until thruDate (after now, at most location@max-share-hours from now), exact or approximate (precisionEnumId LspExact, the default, or LspApproximate), with a trail kept only when keepTrail is true (for trailKeepDays after the share ends, at most and by default location@trail-max-days). audienceList holds at least one entry, each {audienceTypeEnumId, userId, userGroupId, jid}: LsaUser a user the owner may message (the chat directory's rule, ChatServices.get#RefusedUsers with blocks; a user it refuses answers as one that does not exist), LsaUserGroup a group the owner is in now (never ALL_USERS or a group of external users), LsaXmpp a contact of the owner's XMPP roster (username@xmpp-server@domain, XmppServices.get#Roster; kept for the XMPP server to deliver), LsaLink a guest link (one a share), whose token is returned here once and kept only as its digest. Each audience user is told who shares with them and until when (the LocationShared notification). Refused with a reasonCode: BAD_UNTIL, TOO_LONG, BAD_PRECISION, BAD_TRAIL_DAYS, AUDIENCE_EMPTY, BAD_AUDIENCE, USER_NOT_FOUND, GROUP_NOT_ALLOWED, XMPP_OFF, XMPP_NOT_CONTACT, ONE_LINK.

parameter.name: linkToken
parameter.description: The guest link's token, returned this once

service.description: Change an active share of the current user's own: extend or shorten it (thruDate, after now and at most location@max-share-hours from now: extending is the owner's act again), add to its audience (addAudienceList, entries as create#Share's; one already there is passed over), and change its label or purpose. The owner's other devices and the audience are told on locationShare:shareId, and each user added gets the LocationShared notification; a link added returns its token once. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's), SHARE_ENDED, and create#Share's reasons.

Stop a share of the current user's own at once: its latest position is deleted, its audience and the owner's other devices are told on locationShare:shareId, and a device still sending gets 410. A kept trail stays for its trailKeepDays, or until delete#Trail. A share already ended is left as it is. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's).

Take one entry of a share of the current user's own out of its audience (a person, a group, an XMPP contact or the link): it reads nothing from now on, and its users are told on locationShare:shareId. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND (not the caller's), AUDIENCE_NOT_FOUND.

A position of an active share, from its owner only: latitude and longitude (degrees, in range), accuracy (metres, optional), heading (degrees from north) and speed (metres a second), observedDate (when the device took it: not in the future, later than the latest one; now when not given). At most one a location@min-interval-seconds a share: a sooner one is dropped with statusCode 429 (RATE_LIMITED, retryAfterSeconds). An approximate share's position is rounded here to about 1 km (accuracy at least 1000, no heading or speed) before it is stored or sent. It replaces the share's LocationLatest, adds a trail point when the share keeps a trail, and is sent on locationShare:shareId to the audience's current users. statusCode 200; 410 (SHARE_ENDED) for a share ended or stopped, which stops the device; 404 (SHARE_NOT_FOUND) for one that is not the caller's; 400 for a value out of range (BAD_POSITION, BAD_ACCURACY, BAD_HEADING, BAD_SPEED, BAD_DATE); 409 (STALE) for one not later than the latest. A refusal names no value.

The current user's own shares: the active ones, and with includeEnded those ended too (for their kept trails), the newest first, at most 200. Each with its audience (every entry, revoked ones marked: a person's or group's name, a JID, and for the link only that there is one and when it was last viewed, never its token or digest), its end, its latest position while it is active and its trail's size.

The active shares of other people whose current audience holds the current user (as a user whose entry is not revoked, or a current member of a group whose entry is not revoked), soonest to end first, at most 200: the owner's name, the label and purpose, the end, whether it is approximate, and the latest position with its age. The audience is checked at this read, so a person taken out of a group sees nothing of it.

One share for its owner (with its audience as find#MyShares has it), or for a member of its current audience while it is active: the share, its latest position (while active) and, when it keeps a trail, a page of the trail in time order (trailPageIndex, trailPageSize up to 1000) with its count. A share that is not the caller's and whose current audience does not hold the caller, or that has ended for a viewer, answers SHARE_NOT_FOUND.

Delete the whole kept trail of a share of the current user's own, now, whether the share is active or ended; an active share goes on keeping the positions it gets from now on. Refused: SHARE_NOT_FOUND.

The hourly job (clean_LocationShares_hourly): ends the shares past their thruDate (endedDate set, the latest position deleted, the audience told), deletes the trail points of each ended share past its trailKeepDays (at most location@trail-max-days), and removes the shares ended more than location@trail-max-days ago with no trail left, with their audience (the audit log keeps who shared with whom and when). Each share is on its own, in its own transaction: one that fails is logged by its id and the rest go on. Out: endedCount, trailDeletedCount (points), removedCount, failedCount.
